newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends sharply higher on oversold ideas.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends sharply higher on oversold ideas.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended sharply higher on short covering ahead of the three-day Independence Day holiday weekend and on ideas the recent sell-off was overdone, traders said.
"This market was severely oversold as evidence by this bounce," a trader said.
Export sales offered little support. Trade sources said the weekly tally of 14,400 tonnes was within expectation.
Trade sources said the market was beginning to watch crop development in Thailand. Floor sources said rainfall amounts in the major rice producing country were below normal in May and June.
The dryness has been blamed on the developing El Nino phenomenon which has been known to cause droughts from India to Australia.
"July is going to be critical," a trader said. "We're all watching that."
